## Notes
- [Most NZ brands don't need a CDP yet. Fix these four things first.](https://adnan.co.nz/notes/do-you-need-a-cdp): A customer data platform amplifies whatever data you feed it. Here are the four foundations to fix first, and the signs you're ready for a CDP.
- [MMM vs attribution: what marketing mix modelling tells you that last-click never will](https://adnan.co.nz/notes/mmm-vs-attribution): Attribution shows which touchpoint was nearest a sale. Marketing mix modelling estimates what actually caused it. What MMM tells you, what it doesn't, and what to ask before you trust one.
- [Your AI personalisation is only as good as your customer data](https://adnan.co.nz/notes/genai-personalisation-customer-data): Generative AI makes personalisation at scale possible, but only if the customer data underneath is unified, accurate and governed. What customer data infrastructure needs to look like.
